datasets.name: ds_currency_freshness
queryLines: WITH asof AS (SELECT max(signal_date) AS day FROM monitor_daily_signal WHERE monitor_code = 'currency' AND signal_code = 'summary' AND signal_date <= coalesce(:as_of_date, DATE '9999-12-31')) SELECT (SELECT day FROM asof) AS currency_date, (SELECT max(price_date) FROM silver_domain_investments.price_indicator_daily WHERE trading_symbol_code = 'DX-Y.NYB') AS dollar_index_date, (SELECT max(observation_date) FROM silver_domain_investments.market_rate_daily WHERE rate_code = 'us_dollar_broad_index') AS broad_index_date, (SELECT max(observation_date) FROM silver_domain_investments.market_rate_daily WHERE rate_code = 'swiss_francs_per_us_dollar') AS exchange_rate_date

datasets.name: ds_dollar
datasets.displayName: The dollar indexes of the day
queryLines: WITH asof AS (SELECT max(signal_date) AS day FROM monitor_daily_signal WHERE monitor_code = 'currency' AND signal_code = 'summary' AND signal_date <= coalesce(:as_of_date, DATE '9999-12-31')) SELECT s.signal_date, s.signal_code, s.signal_name, CASE WHEN s.is_yes THEN 'Strong' ELSE 'Weak' END AS dollar_state, s.band_code AS dollar_band, CASE s.signal_code WHEN 'dollar_index' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS index_order, s.measured_value AS index_level, s.threshold_value AS average_200, s.reason_text FROM monitor_daily_signal s JOIN asof a ON s.signal_date = a.day WHERE s.monitor_code = 'currency' AND s.signal_code IN ('dollar_index', 'dollar_broad_index') ORDER BY index_order

datasets.name: ds_currency_grid
datasets.displayName: Currencies against the US dollar and the Australian dollar
queryLines: WITH asof AS (SELECT max(signal_date) AS day FROM monitor_daily_signal WHERE monitor_code = 'currency' AND signal_code = 'summary' AND signal_date <= coalesce(:as_of_date, DATE '9999-12-31')), names AS (SELECT * FROM VALUES ('USD', 'US dollar', 1), ('EUR', 'Euro', 2), ('JPY', 'Japanese yen', 3), ('GBP', 'British pound', 4), ('CHF', 'Swiss franc', 5), ('CAD', 'Canadian dollar', 6), ('SEK', 'Swedish krona', 7), ('AUD', 'Australian dollar', 8), ('NZD', 'New Zealand dollar', 9), ('CNY', 'Chinese yuan', 10) AS names(currency_code, currency_name, currency_order)), against_usd AS (SELECT upper(s.signal_code) AS currency_code, s.is_yes, s.band_code, s.measured_value, s.threshold_value FROM monitor_daily_signal s JOIN asof a ON s.signal_date = a.day WHERE s.monitor_code = 'currency' AND s.lens_code = 'us_dollar' AND signal_code NOT IN ('summary', 'dollar_index', 'dollar_broad_index')), against_aud AS (SELECT upper(s.signal_code) AS currency_code, s.is_yes, s.band_code, s.measured_value, s.threshold_value FROM monitor_daily_signal s JOIN asof a ON s.signal_date = a.day WHERE s.monitor_code = 'currency' AND s.lens_code = 'australian_dollar' AND signal_code NOT IN ('summary', 'dollar_index', 'dollar_broad_index')) SELECT n.currency_code, n.currency_name, u.measured_value AS value_in_usd, u.measured_value / u.threshold_value - 1 AS distance_usd, CASE u.is_yes WHEN true THEN 'Gaining' WHEN false THEN 'Losing' ELSE 'Base' END AS against_usd, coalesce(u.band_code, 'blue') AS band_usd, a.measured_value AS value_in_aud, a.measured_value / a.threshold_value - 1 AS distance_aud, CASE a.is_yes WHEN true THEN 'Gaining' WHEN false THEN 'Losing' ELSE 'Base' END AS against_aud, coalesce(a.band_code, 'blue') AS band_aud FROM names n LEFT JOIN against_usd u ON u.currency_code = n.currency_code LEFT JOIN against_aud a ON a.currency_code = n.currency_code ORDER BY n.currency_order

datasets.name: ds_currency_distance
queryLines: WITH asof AS (SELECT max(signal_date) AS day FROM monitor_daily_signal WHERE monitor_code = 'currency' AND signal_code = 'summary' AND signal_date <= coalesce(:as_of_date, DATE '9999-12-31')), names AS (SELECT * FROM VALUES ('USD', 'US dollar', 1), ('EUR', 'Euro', 2), ('JPY', 'Japanese yen', 3), ('GBP', 'British pound', 4), ('CHF', 'Swiss franc', 5), ('CAD', 'Canadian dollar', 6), ('SEK', 'Swedish krona', 7), ('AUD', 'Australian dollar', 8), ('NZD', 'New Zealand dollar', 9), ('CNY', 'Chinese yuan', 10) AS names(currency_code, currency_name, currency_order)), against_usd AS (SELECT upper(s.signal_code) AS currency_code, s.is_yes, s.band_code, s.measured_value, s.threshold_value FROM monitor_daily_signal s JOIN asof a ON s.signal_date = a.day WHERE s.monitor_code = 'currency' AND s.lens_code = 'us_dollar' AND signal_code NOT IN ('summary', 'dollar_index', 'dollar_broad_index')), against_aud AS (SELECT upper(s.signal_code) AS currency_code, s.is_yes, s.band_code, s.measured_value, s.threshold_value FROM monitor_daily_signal s JOIN asof a ON s.signal_date = a.day WHERE s.monitor_code = 'currency' AND s.lens_code = 'australian_dollar' AND signal_code NOT IN ('summary', 'dollar_index', 'dollar_broad_index')) SELECT n.currency_name, n.currency_order, 'Against the US dollar' AS base_label, u.measured_value / u.threshold_value - 1 AS distance_ratio FROM names n JOIN against_usd u ON u.currency_code = n.currency_code UNION ALL SELECT n.currency_name, n.currency_order, 'Against the Australian dollar', a.measured_value / a.threshold_value - 1 FROM names n JOIN against_aud a ON a.currency_code = n.currency_code ORDER BY currency_order

datasets.name: ds_dollar_history
queryLines: SELECT b.indicator_date, d.price_close_adjusted AS dxy_close, d.close_adjusted_two_hundred_day_average_amount AS dxy_average, b.rate_value AS broad_value, b.two_hundred_day_average_value AS broad_average FROM silver_domain_investments.market_rate_indicator_daily b LEFT JOIN silver_domain_investments.price_indicator_daily d ON d.trading_symbol_code = 'DX-Y.NYB' AND d.price_date = b.indicator_date WHERE b.rate_code = 'us_dollar_broad_index' AND b.indicator_date >= add_months(date_trunc('MONTH', current_date()), -35) ORDER BY b.indicator_date

datasets.name: ds_country_rates
datasets.displayName: Interest rates of the main countries
queryLines: WITH asof AS (SELECT max(signal_date) AS day FROM monitor_daily_signal WHERE monitor_code = 'currency' AND signal_code = 'summary' AND signal_date <= coalesce(:as_of_date, DATE '9999-12-31')), countries AS (SELECT * FROM VALUES ('USD', 'US dollar', 'us_federal_funds_effective_rate', 'us_10_year_treasury_yield'), ('EUR', 'Euro', 'euro_area_deposit_facility_rate', 'euro_area_10_year_government_bond_yield'), ('JPY', 'Japanese yen', 'japan_3_month_interbank_rate', 'japan_10_year_government_bond_yield'), ('GBP', 'British pound', 'uk_call_money_rate', 'uk_10_year_government_bond_yield'), ('CHF', 'Swiss franc', 'switzerland_3_month_interbank_rate', 'switzerland_10_year_government_bond_yield'), ('CAD', 'Canadian dollar', 'canada_3_month_interbank_rate', 'canada_10_year_government_bond_yield'), ('SEK', 'Swedish krona', 'sweden_3_month_interbank_rate', 'sweden_10_year_government_bond_yield'), ('AUD', 'Australian dollar', 'rba_cash_rate_target', 'australia_10_year_government_bond_yield'), ('NZD', 'New Zealand dollar', 'new_zealand_3_month_interbank_rate', 'new_zealand_10_year_government_bond_yield'), ('CNY', 'Chinese yuan', 'china_3_month_interbank_rate', '-') AS countries(currency_code, currency_name, short_rate_code, long_rate_code)), latest AS (SELECT i.rate_code, i.rate_value, i.observation_date FROM silver_domain_investments.market_rate_indicator_daily i JOIN asof a ON i.indicator_date = a.day) SELECT c.currency_name AS country_currency, s.rate_value AS short_term_rate, s.observation_date AS short_term_date, CASE WHEN s.observation_date < add_months(a.day, -4) THEN 'Older than 4 months' END AS short_term_note, l.rate_value AS ten_year_yield, l.observation_date AS ten_year_date, CASE WHEN c.long_rate_code = '-' THEN 'Not available' WHEN l.observation_date < add_months(a.day, -4) THEN 'Older than 4 months' END AS ten_year_note FROM countries c CROSS JOIN asof a LEFT JOIN latest s ON s.rate_code = c.short_rate_code LEFT JOIN latest l ON l.rate_code = c.long_rate_code

datasets.name: ds_currency_options
queryLines: WITH names AS (SELECT * FROM VALUES ('USD', 'US dollar', 1), ('EUR', 'Euro', 2), ('JPY', 'Japanese yen', 3), ('GBP', 'British pound', 4), ('CHF', 'Swiss franc', 5), ('CAD', 'Canadian dollar', 6), ('SEK', 'Swedish krona', 7), ('AUD', 'Australian dollar', 8), ('NZD', 'New Zealand dollar', 9), ('CNY', 'Chinese yuan', 10) AS names(currency_code, currency_name, currency_order)) SELECT currency_code, currency_name FROM names ORDER BY currency_order

datasets.name: ds_currency_history
queryLines: SELECT indicator_date, max(CASE WHEN rate_code = concat('currency_value_', lower(:currency_code), '_in_usd') THEN rate_value END) AS value_in_usd, max(CASE WHEN rate_code = concat('currency_value_', lower(:currency_code), '_in_usd') THEN two_hundred_day_average_value END) AS average_in_usd, max(CASE WHEN rate_code = concat('currency_value_', lower(:currency_code), '_in_aud') THEN rate_value END) AS value_in_aud, max(CASE WHEN rate_code = concat('currency_value_', lower(:currency_code), '_in_aud') THEN two_hundred_day_average_value END) AS average_in_aud FROM silver_domain_investments.market_rate_indicator_daily WHERE rate_code IN (concat('currency_value_', lower(:currency_code), '_in_usd'), concat('currency_value_', lower(:currency_code), '_in_aud')) AND indicator_date >= add_months(date_trunc('MONTH', current_date()), -35) GROUP BY indicator_date ORDER BY indicator_date

datasets.name: ds_currency_rates_history
datasets.displayName: Interest rates of the chosen currency's country
queryLines: WITH countries AS (SELECT * FROM VALUES ('USD', 'US dollar', 'us_federal_funds_effective_rate', 'us_10_year_treasury_yield'), ('EUR', 'Euro', 'euro_area_deposit_facility_rate', 'euro_area_10_year_government_bond_yield'), ('JPY', 'Japanese yen', 'japan_3_month_interbank_rate', 'japan_10_year_government_bond_yield'), ('GBP', 'British pound', 'uk_call_money_rate', 'uk_10_year_government_bond_yield'), ('CHF', 'Swiss franc', 'switzerland_3_month_interbank_rate', 'switzerland_10_year_government_bond_yield'), ('CAD', 'Canadian dollar', 'canada_3_month_interbank_rate', 'canada_10_year_government_bond_yield'), ('SEK', 'Swedish krona', 'sweden_3_month_interbank_rate', 'sweden_10_year_government_bond_yield'), ('AUD', 'Australian dollar', 'rba_cash_rate_target', 'australia_10_year_government_bond_yield'), ('NZD', 'New Zealand dollar', 'new_zealand_3_month_interbank_rate', 'new_zealand_10_year_government_bond_yield'), ('CNY', 'Chinese yuan', 'china_3_month_interbank_rate', '-') AS countries(currency_code, currency_name, short_rate_code, long_rate_code)) SELECT i.indicator_date, CASE i.rate_code WHEN c.short_rate_code THEN 'Short-term rate' ELSE '10-year yield' END AS rate_label, i.rate_value FROM countries c JOIN silver_domain_investments.market_rate_indicator_daily i ON i.rate_code IN (c.short_rate_code, c.long_rate_code) WHERE c.currency_code = :currency_code AND i.indicator_date >= add_months(date_trunc('MONTH', current_date()), -35) ORDER BY i.indicator_date

lines:
# Currency Monitor

Is the dollar strong or weak, and which main currencies are gaining or losing against the US dollar and against the Australian dollar?

- A currency is gaining when its value is above its 200-day average
- The US Dollar Index (DXY) is the dollar's megatrend; the Federal Reserve's broad index covers about 26 currencies
- Each value is worked out from the US dollar rates: a Swiss franc in Australian dollars is the franc in US dollars divided by the Australian dollar in US dollars
- Interest rates: the short-term rate and the 10-year yield of each country, with the date of the reading

Change the date at the top. A dollar index above its average is a strong dollar (green: gaining), at or below it a weak dollar (red).

# Currency Deep Dive

Pick a currency: its value in US and Australian dollars against their 200-day averages, and the short-term rate and 10-year yield of its country when it has one.
